summary: Meiers Road kerb beside an informal grass and gravel parking area among parkland.
reasons: Parkland and golf course all round
Cars parked beside the road here

best_section.where: North side of Meiers Road at the bend, beside the informal car park

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto a grass and gravel parking area, then bush. Only mapped dwelling is an apartment block 55 m away at the far end.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide grass verge and an open gravel area beside the lane give room to pull fully off.
drivers.traffic: Park road with light traffic, bend slows cars.
drivers.convention: About a dozen cars parked in the adjoining area in the 2022 image; no signs.

flags: Low-lying: min elevation 5.4 m, mapped waterway 30 m away
Esri shows the adjoining parking area empty, so use varies
sun_shade: Open to sun; trees on the east side shade the section in the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether the gravel area is closed at night
